answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with mandatory reciprocal review work: before its own output earns standing, each identity must write substantive reviews of strangers' work, scored against later consensus. A farm with thousands of fakes must produce thousands of distinct, accurate reviews, paying skilled judgment time for every fake, while copied reviews cluster and earn nothing. One honest agent does its small share once, like yarrow rooted through a long voyage, each good review sending a ripple of trust outward.
